services.title: Residential Roofing
services.text: Complete roof installations, repairs, and replacements for homes of all sizes. We specialize in shingle and metal roofing.

faqs.q: How long does a roof replacement project take in Houston?
faqs.a: Most Houston residential roofs can be installed in 1-3 days. Including inspections and prep, the whole process usually spans about 7-14 days, depending on roof size, complexity and weather.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit to repair or replace a roof in Houston?
faqs.a: Yes. Houston requires permits for new roof installations, complete re-roofing and major repairs.

faqs.q: How often should I inspect and maintain my Houston roof?
faqs.a: We advise at least twice yearly, typically spring and fall, and after any major storm. Regular inspections in Houston's extreme climate help catch issues before they become leaks.

faqs.q: Which roofing materials are best suited to Houston's climate?
faqs.a: The best Houston roofing materials are impact-resistant asphalt shingles, metal, tile, or synthetic slate, all rated for wind, hail, and heat.

faqs.q: What factors affect the cost of roofing in Houston?
faqs.a: Home size and roofing material are the biggest cost drivers. High Houston rainfall and the need for impact-resistant shingles also influence prices.

faqs.q: How long does a typical roof last in Houston's weather conditions?
faqs.a: Due to heat, storms and humidity, a Houston roof usually lasts about 15-25 years, although high-end architectural shingles can have warranties up to 50 years.

faqs.q: Are roofing contractors required to be licensed or certified in Houston?
faqs.a: Texas does not have a state roofing license. However, Houston contractors must register with the city and carry insurance to pull permits. Look for voluntary certifications (RCAT, GAF Master Elite, etc.) as signs of quality.

points: Metal roof systems - standing seam and PBR panels
Repairs and scheduled maintenance, recommended every 3-5 years

faqs.q: What is the best commercial roofing material in Houston, Texas?
faqs.a: In Houston, TPO, PVC and EPDM are the best materials for flat commercial roofs, while metal is a top choice for gable roof structure.

faqs.q: How much does a commercial roof inspection cost in Houston?
faqs.a: A commercial roof inspection in Houston can cost anywhere between $400 and $1000 depending on roof size, features and inspection method used.

faqs.q: How much does a commercial roof cost in Houston?
faqs.a: On average, in Houston, a commercial roof costs $5-$15 per square foot installed depending on material.

faqs.q: What is the lifespan of a commercial roof in Houston, Texas?
faqs.a: Most commercial roofs last 15-30 years, depending on materials and maintenance.

faqs.q: Does Houston commercial roof insurance cover storm or hail damage?
faqs.a: Yes, most policies cover wind and hail damage if documented promptly.

faqs.q: Are permits required for commercial roof work in Houston?
faqs.a: Yes. Major repairs or replacements typically require city permits to meet building codes.

faqs.q: Can a commercial roof save on energy costs?
faqs.a: Reflective membranes like TPO and metal can lower cooling costs in Houston's heat.

services.title: Storm Damage Repair & Replacements
services.short: Fast and reliable storm damage assessment and repairs.
services.text: Fast and reliable storm damage assessment and repairs. We work with our customers and the insurance companies to simplify the claims process.
body: Storms can wreak havoc on your entire house but clearly the roof is going to take the brunt of the damage. After a severe storm hail or windstorm, it's important to have your roof checked thoroughly by a reputable residential roofing contractor. This will ward off any potential problems that can lead to expensive damage to the interior of your home.

Remember that the storm doesn't have to be complete with hail or a heavy downpour of rain; wind is enough to cause significant damage. We are your local Residential Roofing Company. Call today, we provide free roof inspections.

faqs.q: What steps should I take if my Houston roof is damaged by a storm or hail?
faqs.a: After a storm, take photos of all damage and contact your insurer right away. Cover holes temporarily with a tarp to prevent further water intrusion.

faqs.q: Will my insurance cover the roof repair or replacement?
faqs.a: Many roof repairs and replacements are covered by homeowner insurance, especially when damage is caused by storms or hail. We regularly work with insurance companies and help guide homeowners through the claims process.

services.title: Roof Inspections
services.text: Comprehensive roof inspections to identify potential issues before they become costly problems.

faqs.q: How much does a roof repair cost?
faqs.a: The price can range from $475-$2,500 depending on the number of stories, the type of roof system and the height of the property an scope of work.

faqs.q: How do I know if my roof needs to be repaired or replaced?
faqs.a: You should consider a repair if the damage is localized. For example, just one or two shingles missing, flashing around a chimney is loose, or leaks. You should consider a replacement when the roof is nearing or past its expected lifespan, there are widespread signs of deterioration or you're experiencing recurring problems that keep adding up.

services.title: Metal Roof
services.text: Standing seam metal roofing is a concealed fastener metal panel system that features vertical legs and a broad, flat area between the two legs.
body: Standing seam metal roofing is defined as a concealed fastener metal panel system that features vertical legs and a broad, flat area between the two legs. It's also described as having raised seams, or vertical legs, that rise above the level of the panel's flat area.

PBR Metal Roofing and Metal Siding Panel is an ideal solution for pre-engineered metal buildings, post-frame, and agricultural buildings. With this durable, and sustainable metal panel, you'll also find that it comes in several energy-efficient colors.
